vol_rt_waiting_rune: sits cross-legged before a frost rune carved in a flat stone, hand hovering over it, waiting.
vol_rt_stored_lightning: holds a small clay jar sealed with wax in which a trapped lightning bolt crackles faintly.
vol_rt_elder_word: speaks one ancient word in a circle of standing stones, the old carved idols around him seem to listen.
vol_pw_hearth_rune: carves a fire rune into the clay of a peasant hearth, embers glowing in the grooves.
vol_pw_mist_veil: stands in a forest swallowed by thick fog that pours from rune marks on his arms.
vol_pw_thunder_drum: beats a large shaman's drum painted with a thunder sign, storm clouds gathering above him.
vol_pw_frost_breath: exhales a long cold breath that frosts the grass and the beard of a creature before him.
vol_pw_living_spring: kneels by a spring bubbling from the roots of an old oak, cupping the clear water in his hands.
vol_pw_svarog_eye: looks up at a huge burning eye in the night sky above a sacred grove, his staff raised.
vol_pw_sky_father: stands on a hilltop as a lightning bolt strikes the ground beside him, arms spread in welcome.
